title: Nakli Nawab
desc: A nawab's sister falls in love with a pickpocket who is also a poet. However, due to their social status, they cannot be together, which makes the woman give up hope.

title: Dulhan Wahi Jo Piya Man Bhaye
desc: Raja falls in love with Diya in London and returns home to seek his father's approval. However, in a tragic twist, his dying father asks him to marry Tulsi.

title: Tu Mera Hero
desc: To avoid marriage, Radhika runs away from Mumbai and goes to her friend Vijay's village. However, he sends her away to live with his house help, Govind, whom she hates.

title: Sajan Chale Sasural 2
desc: Rani discovers Saajan's singing talent and helps him rise to fame, sparking a romance. However, tensions rise when Saajan expects Rani to sacrifice her dreams for their relationship.

title: Raja Babu
desc: After initial rejection, Raja wins Madhu's heart, but their love story is disrupted when his father arranges a different marriage for him, creating tension.

title: Deewane
desc: Deewana, a rebellious young man, is madly in love with Kiran and the couple is all set to marry. An evil man, Thakur, however, sets his eyes on Kiran and plots to separate the couple.

title: Maine Dil Tujhko Diya
desc: Ajay falls in love with Ayesha, a fellow college student who is the daughter of a rich businessman. However, problems arise when Ayesha's father arranges her marriage to an associate's son.
